description: This PHP class, SchemaHelper, provides utility functions for schema management in a database, including adding, dropping, renaming columns, managing foreign keys, and creating tables, specifically for use within the OrangeHRM installer utility.

classes.name: SchemaHelper
classes.description: A helper class designed to facilitate database schema manipulations such as adding, dropping, and modifying columns and foreign keys, for use during the installation or schema setup phase of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SchemaHelper with a database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the Doctrine DBAL connection object.

methods.name: dropColumn
methods.description: Removes a column from a specified table.

methods.name: dropColumns
methods.description: Removes multiple columns from a specified table.

methods.name: getTableColumn
methods.description: Retrieves the specified column object from a table.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager instance.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column to a table with specified type and options.

methods.name: addOrChangeColumns
methods.description: Adds new columns or updates existing columns based on provided options.

methods.name: changeColumn
methods.description: Modifies an existing column with new options.

methods.name: renameColumn
methods.description: Renames a column in a table.

methods.name: dropForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops foreign key constraints from a table.

methods.name: addForeignKey
methods.description: Adds a foreign key constraint to a table.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a new table with specified charset, collation, and engine options.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the schema.

methods.name: dropPrimaryKey
methods.description: Drops the primary key from a table.

methods.name: getNativeConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the raw PDO connection object.

methods.name: disableConstraints
methods.description: Disables foreign key constraints in the database.

methods.name: enableConstraints
methods.description: Enables foreign key constraints in the database.

methods.name: columnExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific column exists in a table.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops an index from a specified table.
